FactoryEvent.description: Normalized event stream emitted by a Factory harness connection.

oneOf.description: The completed turn status is authoritative for operation outcome.
Any notification added by a newer pinned Codex revision remains observable instead of being dropped during decoding.

FactoryItem.description:
Stable Factory projection of a Codex thread item.

Every known projection carries the complete original payload in `raw`, so consumers can use the stable fields without losing pinned upstream data.

oneOf.description: Forward-compatible representation for a new or intentionally opaque upstream item. `value` is the complete original item payload.

FactoryJsonlMessage.description: One JSON value per line. Deliberately follows app-server JSON-RPC semantics without adding a `jsonrpc` member.

FactoryKnownServerRequestMethod.description:
A server-request method selected by the pinned Factory Protocol adapter.

This enum is deliberately closed over the nine non-deprecated app-server request pairs that Factory Protocol V1 supports. Use [`FactoryServerRequestMethod`] when an arbitrary upstream method must be retained losslessly.

FactoryMethod.description: Stable operation discriminator used to correlate a response with the request that selected its result schema.

FactoryMethodNotSupportedResolution.description: Required resolution for an unknown app-server request: reply with JSON-RPC method-not-supported and terminate the affected operation.

FactoryRawServerRequest.description: Exact raw app-server request shape. Keeping this beside a typed projection prevents newly-added or deliberately unprojected params from being lost.

FactoryRawServerResponse.description: Exact raw typed-response shape. The raw response remains available even when the known response projection does not model a newly-added field.

FactoryRequestEnvelope.description: Factory-owned request surface. Method names intentionally match the stable app-server V2 operations selected for Protocol V1.

FactoryRpcRequestId.description:
JSON-RPC request identifier used by the Codex app-server wire protocol.

App-server accepts either a string or a signed integer and requires the response to echo the same representation. Keeping this separate from [`FactoryRequestId`] prevents a numeric upstream request id from being coerced into a string at the Factory boundary.

FactoryServerErrorResponse.description: Owned JSON-RPC error response for an app-server initiated request.

FactoryServerRequest.description: A typed request initiated by Codex app-server and delivered to the Factory host. The request id must be echoed unchanged in the matching response.

FactoryServerRequestIdentity.description: Stable identity used to pair an app-server initiated request with exactly one Factory response.

FactoryServerResponse.description: A typed response to a [`FactoryServerRequest`]. The method and id allow the adapter to verify that a response is paired with the correct request before converting its payload to the app-server result value.

raw.description: Complete pinned app-server thread payload, including turns, items, pagination-related fields, and fields not projected in Protocol V1.
Complete pinned app-server turn payload, including the original items and item-view metadata.
Complete response payload, including fork history and loaded items.
Complete response payload, including initial turn pages and cursors.
